{"node_label":"Generate Applicant Url","python_code":"doc = variables.get("doc")
site_url=frappe.utils.get_url()
url=site_url+"/app/job-applicant/"+doc.name
hr_heads = frappe.db.sql("""
SELECT user.name,user.full_name
FROM `tabUser` user
JOIN `tabHas Role` has_role ON has_role.parent = user.name
WHERE has_role.role = %s
""", ("HR Head",), as_dict=True)
filtered_hr_heads = [item for item in hr_heads if item['name'] != 'Administrator']
mails = ','.join([item['name'] for item in filtered_hr_heads])
hr_head_names = ','.join([item['full_name'] for item in filtered_hr_heads])
recruiter_name=frappe.db.get_value("User", variables.get("trigger_user_id"), "full_name")
variables["url"] = url
variables["hr_heads_str"]=mails
variables["hr_head_names"]=hr_head_names
variables["recruiter_id"]=variables.get("trigger_user_id")
variables["recruiter_name"]=recruiter_name
frappe.db.set_value("Job Applicant",doc.name,"status","HR Head Approval Pending")
applicant_doc=frappe.get_doc("Job Applicant",doc.name)
child = applicant_doc.append('custom_crm_note', {})
child.note ="Request To HR Head"
child.added_by = variables.get("trigger_user_id")
child.added_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
child.custom_comment_type = "Recruiter Request To HR Head Approval"
applicant_doc.save()","skip_queue_and_execute_immediately":true,"execute_current_node_as_user":"","submit":true,"variable_path_for_output":""}

{"node_label":"Json Correction","python_code":"cur_data = variables.get("refined_data")
json_data = json.loads(cur_data)
doc = variables.get("doc")

doctype = doc.doctype
docname = doc.name

json_data_copy = json_data.copy()

keys_to_delete = ["resume_attachment", "status"]

for key in list(json_data_copy.keys()):
    if key in keys_to_delete:
       del json_data_copy[key]

json_data_copy["doctype"] = doctype
json_data_copy["name"] = docname

variables["doctype"] = doctype
variables["docname"] = docname

variables["json_data"] = json.dumps(json_data_copy, indent=2)","submit":true,"variable_path_for_output":""}
